messages:
Priya Shah: Orbit (ReadySet) final go/no-go next Wed. Need alignment on committed GPUs, autoscale policy, and the load test owner. Short on time so tagging owners here.
Sam Patel: I can coordinate the customer side and run the enablement call Mon. They want minimal disruption and a clear rollback plan.
Mateo Flores: I'll own the load test. Proposed commit: 6g reserved, autoscale to 12g. Test profile: 900 concurrent, 20k tokens/min sustained, 45k token/min peak for 90m.
Erin Kline: Customer asked for <200ms median token latency at p95. Can we validate that within the private VPC?
Alex Morgan: Yes, but long-context prompts (>=2k) will push tail latencies. We'll capture per-token and per-sequence percentiles. Recommend autoscale trigger at 65% GPU util with 3-min cooldown to reduce churn.
Jordan Li: Ops note: staging-vpc has a 4g pool. We need quota request to add temporary 4g for the ramp. Filing now.
capacity-bot: Quota request created: QR-78122. Status: PENDING_APPROVAL.
Mateo Flores: Load plan outline: 1) seed KV cache with 200 common prefixes (30m), 2) priming traffic (200 req/min, 20m), 3) ramp to profile over 40m, 4) 90m soak at target, 5) chaos tests: instance drain + model fallback. Will run vegeta + a separate long-context script.
Priya Shah: Please paste the exact command you'll run and expected outputs so CSM can track. Also ensure results land in the shared runbook doc.
Mateo Flores: Vegeta snippet (will run from staging host in PEER VPC): ```echo "POST https://private-api.orbit.readyset/v1/generate" | vegeta attack -rate=300 -duration=40m -connections=900 -header 'Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY' -header 'Content-Type: application/json' | vegeta report -type=json > orbit-load-report.json```
Alex Morgan: Add a second job for 4k-length sequences to exercise KV cache eviction: k6 scenario with VUs=200, duration=30m, exec="longChat".
Erin Kline: Reminder: KMS access for their key must be verified before the run. Sam, can you confirm engineering has granted cross-account KMS decrypt?
Sam Patel: Confirmed with their infra team; cross-account grant is in place. I'll attach the allowlist in the runbook.
Jordan Li: Quota QR-78122 APPROVED. Nodes provisioned in staging-vpc in 12 minutes. capacity-bot will post node readiness.
capacity-bot: QR-78122 status: APPROVED. 4g added to staging-vpc pool. Nodes initializing.
Priya Shah: Who is on-call Friday for the test window? Need primary + backup + pager escalation.
Jordan Li: I'll be primary, Erin backup. Sam will be customer liaison on the call.
Mateo Flores: Scheduling: Full run Friday 08:30 PT. I'll shift to 09:30 PT if there's any maintenance. Also will upload orbit-load-report.json and a short summary: peak_concurrent, tokens_per_sec, autoscale_events, errors, latency_p50/p95/p99.
Priya Shah: Add enablement checklist: runbook walkthrough, API key rotation guidance, monitoring dashboard links, and post-run renewal discussion (we need sign-off within 72 hrs of successful soak).
Alex Morgan: Yes. I'll run cost projections once we have real peak numbers and include a per-month committed vs on-demand comparison.
Mateo Flores: Quick note: I'll seed KV cache before the penultimate test so we can compare cold vs warm latencies.
capacity-bot: Autoscaler maintenance window scheduled: 2026-03-27 08:00-09:00 UTC. No scaling during this time.
Priya Shah: Avoid running during maintenance. Mateo please confirm the final start time by EOD.
Mateo Flores: Confirmed Friday 09:30 PT start to avoid maintenance. I'll post the runbook link here and update with results: https://docs.redwood.example/readyset/orbit-warmup (shared).
Sam Patel: Customer enablement call set Monday 15:00 PT — Sam + Priya + customer SREs.
Priya Shah: Great. Final action list: Mateo - run tests & upload results; Jordan - provision + oncall; Alex - fallback + cost delta; Erin - enablement checklist & runbook; Sam - customer liaison and KMS confirmation; Priya - renewal sign-off coordination. :thumbsup:
Mateo Flores: Copy. Starting artifact prep now.
Jordan Li: Nodes reporting ready. capacity-bot will post the allocation log.
capacity-bot: Nodes ready in staging-vpc. 4g added, total staging pool: 8g.
Priya Shah: Thanks team. Reconvene here after results. End.
